title: Concept: Shell command built from string interpolation in julia — review required
description: In julia, a command is assembled by interpolation inside backticks. Julia passes the resulting string to the shell, so quoting rules apply and interpolated text is not escaped. Separate interpolation forms ($var inside the literal as its own argument) are safer because they avoid re-parsing.
applicability: julia scripts that invoke external tools.
risk: Shell injection with process privileges; HIGH severity.
